info.name: Familiar Trainer
info.description: The Familiar Trainer background from Arcana Unleashed.

ul.li: Skill Proficiencies: Animal Handling and Arcana
Tool Proficiency: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Quarterstaff, Gaming Set (same as above), Bedroll, Bell, String, Tinderbox, Traveler's Clothes, Waterskin, 44 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description.p: A magical familiar bonded with you when you were young, accompanying you throughout your adolescence. Now, you can't imagine life without your furry—or feathery, scaly, or slimy—friend at your side. You've learned to work in tandem with your familiar, and when adventure presents its challenges, your familiar is quick to remind you of the small joys in life.

setters.set: Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, Familiar Friend Feat, Animal Handling and Arcana Skills, a Gaming Set
